name: fortinet-mcp
description: Read every FortiGate's configuration and live state, then audit the whole client fleet for firmware, SSL-VPN exposure, admin accounts and license expiry in one command.

fortinet_base_url.title: FortiGate API URL
fortinet_base_url.description: Sets FORTINET_BASE_URL, your FortiGate's REST API root, e.g. https://203.0.113.10:8443/api/v2.

fortinet_api_token.title: FortiGate REST API token
fortinet_api_token.description: Sets FORTINET_API_TOKEN: the FortiGate REST API admin token (System > Administrators > Create New > REST API Admin). Use a read-only admin profile.

fortinet_devices.title: Devices file (fleet commands)
fortinet_devices.description: Optional. Path to a devices.toml listing every FortiGate the fleet, audit and policies hygiene commands check, each with a token_file. Leave blank to check only the FortiGate above.

fortinet_fmg_url.title: FortiManager URL
fortinet_fmg_url.description: Optional. https://<fortimanager> for the read-only fmg commands. Leave blank if you do not use FortiManager.

fortinet_fmg_api_key.title: FortiManager API key
fortinet_fmg_api_key.description: Optional. API key of a FortiManager REST API admin (FortiManager 7.2.2 or later) for the fmg commands.

fortinet_cloud_api_user.title: FortiCloud IAM API user ID
fortinet_cloud_api_user.description: Optional. FortiCloud IAM API user (with FortiGate Cloud portal permission) for the read-only cloud commands.

fortinet_cloud_api_password.title: FortiCloud IAM API user password
fortinet_cloud_api_password.description: Optional. Password of the FortiCloud IAM API user. Repeated failed logins lock the FortiCloud account for 15-30 minutes.

fortinet_cloud_region.title: FortiGate Cloud region
fortinet_cloud_region.description: Optional. global (default), us, eu or jp: the region your FortiGates were provisioned in.

fortinet_cloud_account_id.title: FortiCloud account ID
fortinet_cloud_account_id.description: Optional. Required only when FortiCloud Organizations are enabled.

fortinet_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
fortinet_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to 1 to expose only read-only mirrored tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

fortinet_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
fortinet_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport Claude Desktop uses.

fortinet_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
fortinet_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to your FortiGates. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
